message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Notes |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | The first book in the Harry Potter series; introduces Harry, Hogwarts, and the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Harry returns to Hogwarts for his second year and faces the mystery of the Chamber. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Features the Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Focuses on Harry’s fifth year and the rise of the Ministry’s opposition. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince** | 2005 | Explores Voldemort’s past and the final battle. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Concludes the series with the final showdown between Harry and Voldemort. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a dark political drama set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | A crime thriller featuring private detective Cormoran Strike. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Continues the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Another installment in the Cormoran Strike saga. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | The latest book in the Cormoran Strike series (as of 2026). |

These titles have been bestsellers worldwide and have garnered a massive fan base across all age groups.
